query: We're adding an AI refund workflow to our FastAPI service. Email and Slack should enter the same flow, refunds over $500 need a manager, and jobs must resume after deploys. Help me design the architecture before we choose an agent framework.
Audit src/agent and docs/workflow.md for why our customer-facing tool-calling agent keeps looping and can't resume after a webhook. I want evidence-backed architecture findings, not prompt tweaks.
Our LangGraph app works in demos but the framework owns the message history and retry loop. Review what we have and propose a migration that can keep LangGraph where it helps.
Design a human approval flow for an LLM deployment agent. The approver may answer hours later by email, callbacks can arrive twice, and the worker won't stay alive.
Can you review whether this agent's prompts, context builder, tool schemas, state persistence, retries, and control flow are ready for production? Cite code lines for every verdict.
We need an auditable claims-triage LLM for a regulated insurer. Map which decisions belong to the model, policy code, or humans, and define replay and idempotency requirements.

The bot is stuck at about 80% reliability: long runs forget earlier constraints, malformed tool calls sometimes reach handlers, and failures retry forever. Diagnose the architecture and give a prioritized target design.
Before we implement this agentic feature, turn the product requirements into a concrete event/state/control-flow design with launch, pause, resume, cancellation, and acceptance tests.
Please assess our PydanticAI workflow against HumanLayer's 12-Factor Agents principles, but don't penalize us merely for using a framework or inline prompt constants.
Review an architecture spec for a multi-tenant LLM tool runner. Focus on typed outputs, authorization before effects, durable correlation IDs, error compaction, and reproducible model inputs.
Convert this Rails service to follow the Twelve-Factor App methodology: config in env vars, stateless processes, backing services, logs, and dev/prod parity.
Rewrite this system prompt so the assistant sounds warmer and stops using bullet points. Don't change the application architecture.
Compare GPT-5, Claude Opus, and Gemini pricing, context limits, tool calling accuracy, and latency for our chatbot procurement decision.
Do a normal code review of this TypeScript pull request. It changes date formatting and React component props; there are no model calls.
Scaffold a runnable TypeScript AI agent project with package.json, Dockerfile, OpenAI client, tests, and a Slack bot. I want files, not an architecture review.
Threat-model our LLM service for prompt injection, SSRF, data exfiltration, tenant isolation, and secrets leakage. Produce a security assessment.
Add OpenTelemetry spans and dashboards to our existing agent service. We already know the architecture; focus only on instrumentation code and Grafana panels.
Benchmark whether our RAG answer accuracy improves when chunk size changes from 400 to 800 tokens. Build an experiment and analyze the results.
Explain factor 3 from the HumanLayer 12-Factor Agents article in two paragraphs. I only need a conceptual summary, not a design or audit.
Fix the failing retry test in src/worker.test.ts. The desired retry policy is already documented; diagnose the code bug and implement the patch.
